text:
Anna Liu: FYI I just rolled FP8+INT8 kernel selector change into staging and seeing a weird perf regression on Mistral-7B-v2 when KV cache hit ratio is high.

Kevin Park: repro steps?

Anna Liu: short repro: single-client chat load with long context (~8k). Before change tail p95 gen latency ~120ms/token; after change ~190ms/token.

Reza Mahdavi: did you change batching heuristics or only kernel selection thresholds?

Anna Liu: only kernel selector thresholds and enabling FP8 path for matmul. Batching config untouched.

Ciara O'Neill: can you paste the selector config you used?

Anna Liu: sure:```json
{
  "selector_order": ["fp8_fastpath","int8_fallback","fp16"],
  "min_seq_for_fp8": 32,
  "kv_cache_sensitive": true,
  "kv_cache_threshold": 0.6
}
```

Maria Gomez: hmm kv_cache_sensitive=true means we re-evaluate kernel per request based on cache hit ratio. If hits>0.6 we pick FP8 path which expects contiguous KV layout; maybe our KV-copy on long contexts is adding memcpy overhead.

Anna Liu: yeah I saw spikes in memcpy in perf profile. Snippet from perf-bench:```text
[profile] top functions
1  memcpy 40.2%
2  fp8_gemm_fastpath 22.1%
3  kv_read_copy 12.6%
4  dispatch_kernel 5.3%
```

perf-bot: new benchmark run attached:
model,mode,context,p95_ms_per_token
Mistral-7B-v2,master,8k,120
Mistral-7B-v2,fp8-selector,8k,190
Qwen-7B,fp8-selector,8k,130
Llama-2-7B,fp8-selector,8k,115

Reza Mahdavi: interesting Qwen+Llama not impacted. So it's model-specific. Maybe Mistral's KV layout or attention implementation interacts poorly with fp8 path.

Ciara O'Neill: can we toggle kv_cache_sensitive -> false and just use sequence-length threshold to avoid per-request branching?

Anna Liu: tried that. Setting kv_cache_sensitive=false and min_seq_for_fp8=64 brings p95 back down to ~125ms but throughput drops at lower seqs.

Kevin Park: tradeoff. Could we add a small micro-optimization: avoid memcpy by exposing KV pointers to fp8 kernels when safe? That requires sync with allocator.

Anna Liu: risky for short cycle. Also need to ensure alignment for fp8 kernels (4-byte alignment). Right now we copy and align.

Maria Gomez: other option: add a cheap heuristics pass that samples kv hit pattern for first N tokens and choose kernel once per session. Avoid per-request check.

Reza Mahdavi: I can prototype session-level sticky selector. If we sample 3 requests and hits>80% pick fp8. If not, stick with int8.

Anna Liu: that'll avoid repeated memcpy toggles. Can you test on staging?

Reza Mahdavi: will do. Also will run kv layout analyzer for Mistral to see why memcpy cost is high.

perf-bot: scheduled run by @Reza at 2028-11-02T09:16:30Z (job id sj-8921).

Ciara O'Neill: if prototype looks good, add a config knob to console: "selector.session_sticky_sampling" with default on. Document in release notes.

Kevin Park: one more ask: capture a short perf trace with LTO and kernel timestamps. Use `run-bench --trace-kernels --kv-sample=128`.

Anna Liu: doing that now, will paste logs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
